method: scripts/quality/audit-interruptions.py boots an app, switches the simulator scenario mid-session (host-down, network-timeout, storage-full), then drives the flow that must fail gracefully. Shots are visually verified; the sim log confirms the fault reached the app.

cases.rss-host-down: pass: "The service did not answer. Try again." with a retry; feed list intact
cases.rss-network-timeout: pass: "The request took too long. Try again.", distinct from host-down, with a retry
cases.panels-storage-full: pass: "This comic is missing from the reader."; library intact, no crash
cases.parser-storage-full: pass: "The save could not be written. Check free space."; the story continues
cases.todo-storage-full: found and fixed: a refused save showed nothing and a relaunch would lose the item. Root cause: on_save routed only export keys, so the list save answer never reached on_store. Fix forwards answers, banners both list screens until a save lands, and measures around the banner (9039a641, todo 1.0.10).

offline: covered by the APPQA-07 relaunch audit (44/44 apps reopen after offline)
delayed: the sim has no slow-transfer scenario; the timeout path is the delayed case and is covered above
